subject.title: fix(agents): carry provenance through active subagent wakes

question: Should active-wake `inputProvenance` be exposed through the public `AgentSession.steer` plugin SDK surface, or kept as internal runtime queue metadata while preserving current transcript-recorder queueing?
rationale: The bug fix needs provenance on active wakes, but the submitted shape changes a plugin-visible agent-session method and conflicts with current main's queued transcript recorder contract; automation cannot choose the permanent SDK boundary safely.

options.title: Keep Provenance Internal
options.body: Rebase the PR so active wake queueing adds provenance through internal queue options while preserving current `userTurnTranscriptRecorder` behavior and avoiding a new public plugin API unless separately approved.

options.title: Approve Public Steer Options
options.body: Accept `AgentSessionSteerOptions` as a new plugin-visible API and require docs/tests that explain who may set provenance and how it composes with existing image and transcript-recorder steering.

options.title: Pause For Broader Route Work
options.body: Hold this PR until the related sessions_yield and interactive steering route work settles if maintainers want one coordinated session-state contract instead of a narrow provenance patch.

recommendation.title: Keep Provenance Internal
recommendation.body: Rebase the PR so active wake queueing adds provenance through internal queue options while preserving current `userTurnTranscriptRecorder` behavior and avoiding a new public plugin API unless separately approved.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the most frequent sampled contributor across the central subagent announce and embedded-runner routing files, making him the best available owner for the API-boundary choice.
